results.title: Carousel
results.overview: A divorced doctor’s carefully constructed life in Cleveland is upended when his daughter’s debate aspirations and the unexpected return of a past love force him to confront his own choices and embrace a second chance.

results.title: WomanInFan
results.overview: WomanInFan was born in 2021 as part of the Sitges Film Festival to promote the role of women in all spheres of fantastic genre filmmaking. Five years after its inception, Mònica Garcia Massagué, the initiative’s creator, showcases the project’s growth and development in a documentary featuring some of the women honored at the Festival, including filmmaker Mary Lambert or actress Helga Liné.

results.title: Dance Fight
results.overview: Dance Fight is an action-comedy about a young man with a penchant for dance who enters the tournament of a lifetime against his long-time idol, the greatest dancer in the world!

results.title: Heat in the Barrio
results.overview: Maribel and Jorge’s walk to school is no easy feat, as a zoot-suit-wearing Pachuco is hot on their trail, leaving the children to question the future of their community in the climate he creates.

results.title: Anom Suraya
results.overview: # Translation  The story follows Anom (Daiyan Trisha), a simple village girl who accepts a job offer as a caregiver at Puan Raden's house in Kuala Lumpur to change her fate. There, Anom is tasked with looking after Badrol (Yusuf Bahrin), Puan Raden's son who suffers from mental disturbance, believed to be caused by black magic. Although initially frightened, Anom manages to get close to and calm Badrol with sincerity and music. As Badrol recovers, Anom's relationship with Badrol's older brother, Bakhtiar (Idris Khan), grows closer, leading to a marriage proposal. However, Badrol's love and jealousy towards Anom sparks conflict between the two brothers, compounded by slander and a struggle for affection that tears the family apart. Caught between love, responsibility, and compassion, Anom eventually chooses to return to her village to find peace. After returning Bakhtiar's engagement ring, she loses the man she loves, while Badrol sinks back into emotional distress.

results.title: Marie Göranzon - När rampljuset slocknar
results.overview: She has been on stage for over sixty years and has played all the great female roles. Now she is working on a new play, but at the same time she is facing the end at the age of 83 – and it doesn’t feel nice. Already in 1969, Marie met her great love, the actor Jan Malmsjö. Now she talks about the great passion that struck her even though she was already married, and about what everyday love looks like in older age.

results.title: Mr. Shota's Last Business Trip
results.overview: Shota, a machinist who dedicated his life to his work, prepares for his final business trip to Korea before retiring. Meanwhile, Daesung heads to Japan to win back his ex-girlfriend. The two men happen to meet at a ramen shop on the first day of their journeys. When Shota's resignation letter and Daesung's love letter are swapped, an unexpected story begins.

results.title: Top
results.overview: Finally at the hospital for his long awaited gender affirming top surgery, Matt Levit, with lively girlfriend Leisha Meyer by his side, navigates the bureaucracy of the top surgery process. But once Matt is thrown deep into surgery day, he suddenly finds his present intertwining with his past self, Kimberly. Plunging through past and present, Matt is dropped into confronting his relationship with his chest and sudden loss of his mother, Nancy.

results.title: Sparks
results.overview: Two late-20s Londoners walk home from their first date and see the exact life they will have if they pursue the sparks between them.

results.title: Still Water
results.overview: A small-town beauty pageant queen, trapped by scripted smiles and expectations of perfection, secretly finds freedom in fishing and must decide whether to maintain her poise on stage or reclaim her true identity before the State pageant.

results.title: Stay in the car
results.overview: Set against the dim glow of streetlights and the hum of passing sirens, Stay in the Car captures one night in the life of a fifteen-year-old girl waiting in her mother's El Camino and the quiet reckoning that unfolds in the stillness. Based on real events, Stay in the Car explores the fragile line between safety and survival, love and neglect. It invites audiences into a world where survival depends on silence, and one young girl must decide whether to remain in her mother's chaos or step into her own uncertain freedom.

results.title: Red Flags
results.overview: After hundreds of bad dates, a chance meeting brings two people, in the same boat, together.

results.title: Huwag Kang Titingin
results.overview: A group of friends triggers a supernatural curse through a social media trend, unleashing ancient, sinister forces tied to local myths.

results.title: The Wartime Post 1942
results.overview: On 7 February 1942, in the hardest years of the resistance, the CPC Shandong bureau and the Shandong wartime government established the Shandong Wartime Post General Bureau in Shuangquan Yuzi village, Mashichi township, Yinan county, in the Yimeng mountains — a wartime communications organisation combining intra-party transport, party-newspaper distribution and postal service.

results.title: Tunnel 26: The Curse Beneath the Mountain
results.original_title: Tunnel 26: The Curse Beneath the Mountain
results.overview: When an event triggers a blockage of tunnel in a hydro power project in Bhutan, frantic rescue teams from Nepal and Bhutan race against time to save the trapped workers and students unaware that an ancient gate has been unsealed and the survivors are battling not just the rubble, but a rising tide of possession and karmic doom.
